__comment: Chariot Production Drift Detection. Import into Grafana via Dashboard > Import > JSON. Requires Loki datasource uid 'grafanacloud-logs' and pm2 log stream. NOT auto-deployed.
title: Chariot Production Drift Detection

panels.title: Top-1 Selection Accuracy — 7-day rolling drift overlay
panels.description: Hourly top-1 accuracy from synthetic golden-query replay. Drift fires when z-score > 2 over the 7-day rolling window.

targets.expr: sum_over_time({service="pm2"} | json | type="drift-detected" | signal="top1Accuracy" | unwrap currentValue [1h])

panels.title: Per-Adapter Error Rate — drift overlay
panels.description: Fraction of adapter calls ending isError=true per 1-hour window. Drift fires when z-score > 2.

targets.expr: sum by (adapterId) (count_over_time({service="pm2"} | json | type="result" | isError="true" [1h])) / sum by (adapterId) (count_over_time({service="pm2"} | json | type="result" [1h]))

panels.title: Per-Adapter Mean Retry Count — drift overlay
panels.description: Mean retryCount per adapter as recorded by the DriftDetector's meanRetry:<adapterId> signal. The series reads currentValue from the drift-detected event payload, matching the data path Panels 1 and 4 use. Drift fires when the DriftDetector's z-score exceeds 2 over the 7-day rolling window; the alert is recorded in the drift event itself rather than overlaid as a static threshold here.

targets.expr: sum by (signal) (sum_over_time({service="pm2"} | json | type="drift-detected" | signal=~"meanRetry:.+" | unwrap currentValue [1h]))

panels.title: Ensemble-Judge Verdict Distribution — drift overlay
panels.description: Fraction PASS / (PASS+FAIL) from ensemble-judge scoring the synthetic replay. Only populated when CHARIOT_EVAL_RUN_LLM=1 and judge keys are present. Drift fires when z-score > 2.

targets.expr: sum_over_time({service="pm2"} | json | type="drift-detected" | signal="verdictDist" | unwrap currentValue [1h])

panels.title: Drift Alerts (last 24h)
panels.description: Count of drift-alert JSONL entries in the last 24 hours across all signals.

panels.title: Recent Drift Events
panels.description: Latest drift entries from the JSONL file via Loki. Columns: signal, z-score, currentValue, rollingMean, timestamp.
